notes.content: [p]Notebook Update. Now the questions and answers are much more clear and organized. Let's see if the answers you receive will help you solve the problems.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618583/9894a58b72ffa043af095be149316b783dcdc48c.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Evidence Update
notes.content: [p]Evidence visuals have been added. Now the game is more colorful and more fun. Have a more fun gaming experience with visuals prepared according to the scenarios. Stay tuned for more updates. Don't forget to join our discord server and share your valuable thoughts to share your requests with us![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618583/17c513b9f3f9c75fb213d6f6219d4fe44d8680ca.png"][/img][/p][p]Discord:[url="https://discord.gg/Dwp6ZxBD"]https://discord.gg/Dwp6ZxBD[/url][/p]

notes.title: Character Update
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618583/e28a6f3cdfdcbc53f4f0005b21011bea9e626b3b.png"][/img]The expected character update has arrived. We have updated our character models in line with the requests of our valued players. We continue to work on your other requests. Thank you for your interest. Be sure that we will make our game the best with your requests. Have fun :)[/p]

notes.title: Update
notes.content: The number of scenarios has been increased. The variety has been increased. The language selection screen at the beginning of the game has been arranged.
